title: Hello Solidity — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Hello Solidity solution should meet the objective: Create, compile, and deploy a simple contract to a local virtual machine. Verify one public read and document the compiler and environment used. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
